If the implementation instead tries to calculate `body_frag_len` based on the raw `recv_buf` length (`data_len` in the diagram) and `body_frag_start` (offset into the raw buffer), it will incorrectly include chunk framing bytes, leading to an overcount.

This contradicts the diagram's interpretation of `data len` as the raw buffer length.

To resolve this ambiguity and guide the `http_client` implementation to correctly handle chunked transfer encoding, the misleading diagram and formula will be removed from `include/zephyr/net/http/client.h`. Additionally, the descriptions of `body_frag_start`, `body_frag_len`, and `data_len` will be clarified to explicitly state that they refer to *decoded* body data.
